verdict.rationale: Inngest is a hosted platform with a REST API, MCP server, and CLI that give agents access, so scoped credentials are a fair question to ask. Nothing in the evidence documents issuing scoped, least-privilege, or per-agent API keys. Agent access through the MCP server or CLI is an adjacent feature and does not show credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
